text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"HARD ANODIZING"}],"comment":"The heat treatment field lists 'HARD ANODIZING', which is a surface coating, not a heat treatment. This mislabeling can cause the shop to skip actual heat treatment or apply the anodizing at the wrong manufacturing stage; the designer should move 'HARD ANODIZING' to the surface treatment field and specify any required heat treatment with its applicable stage.","recommended_correction":"Move hard anodizing to the surface treatment field only, and enter the correct heat treatment specification (or 'NONE') with the stage it applies at."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D12","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 16 H7 (+0.018/0)"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"HARD ANODIZING"}],"comment":"The ⌀16 H7 hole (D12) carries a tight fit tolerance but no allowance for the hard anodizing specified in the title block, which adds measurable thickness inside the bore. Without accounting for the coating, the finished hole will be undersize and the intended fit will fail; the designer should either mask the hole during anodizing or adjust the pre-coat machining dimension to leave room for the plating thickness.","recommended_correction":"Add a note specifying that the ⌀16 H7 hole is to be masked during hard anodizing, or reduce the pre-coat hole size by twice the expected anodize thickness so the final coated diameter meets H7."}]}
